text.p: Foamex International Inc Chairman Marshall Cogan said Monday the packaging and automotive foam maker has been approached four times in the past few months about "strategic alliances".

Speaking at a Montgomery Securities investment conference here, Cogan declined to elaborate about the alliances or which firms had expressed interest. However, he said Foamex is always looking for ways to enhance shareholder value.
He said the parties were interested in the company's variable pressure foam manufacturing process, which reduces manufacturing costs.
In the past year Foamex has sold two units because of rising materials costs.
